events.verdict: Williams (CHA) and Daniels (ATL) come together at the same spot as they pursue the rebound, and the contact as Daniels secures the rebound is marginal.
During the drive, Richards (CHA) brings his hands toward Hunter's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs before he gathers to shoot.
Williams (CHA) moves toward the imminent inbound passer to defend the ensuing inbound play when his leg inadvertently makes contact with the ball.
Williams (CHA) moves laterally and forward into Johnson (ATL) to initiate illegal body contact, which affects Johnson's SQBR.

After the first made free throw, Williams (CHA) takes the ball from the official and wipes the sweat from his face onto the ball. The official has to clean the ball before giving it back to the free throw shooter and a delay of game is correctly assessed to the Hornets.
Okongwu (ATL) jumps vertically and is turned in the air as he absorbs the incidental contact from Bridges' (CHA) during the driving shot attempt.

Mann (CHA) moves alongside Johnson's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs as Johnson releases back toward the perimeter. Johnson temporarily loses his balance on his own accord and there is no illegal contact from Mann.
Daniels (ATL) is moving alongside Mann's (CHA) path and maintains a legal guarding position as Daniels cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
Bridges (CHA) extends his right forearm into Young's (ATL) upper body and initiates contact that affects Young's ability to gather the ball.
Hunter (ATL) moves laterally into Bridges' (CHA) path and initiates body contact that affects Bridges' SQBR as he comes across midcourt.

Replay review of the foul called on Mann (CHA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Mann (CHA) moves laterally into Young's (ATL) path and initiates body contact that affects Young's SQBR as he dribbles near the sideline.
Williams (CHA) and Hunter (ATL) come together as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Bridges (CHA) commits a take foul on Johnson (ATL).
Johnson (ATL) and Williams (CHA) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the inbound screen. Williams loses his balance on his own accord.
Daniels (ATL) retreats away from, and lands short of, Mann (CHA), who lunges toward the basket on his deep three-point attempt.  The contact is caused by Mann and is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Bridges (CHA) during the rebound.
